description.value: The Metropole Community Pub — known locally as 'The Met' — is a casual neighbourhood bar in Vancouver's Gastown district, offering drink specials, food, pool, skeeball, and a ping pong table. The pub has been operating since at least 2017 and maintains an active social calendar including Super Bowl watch parties and New Year's events. Its Gastown location puts it within easy reach of the seawall and downtown cycling routes.
